schema.description:
A public booking intent that tracks the lifecycle of a booking attempt.
This is a simplified view without sensitive or admin-only fields.

anyOf.description: A public appointment represents a booking that a client has made with a provider for a service.

rescheduling.disabled_message: Rescheduling is not available within 24 hours of your appointment

cancellation.description: Information about whether the appointment can be canceled by the client.

allowed.description: Whether the appointment can be canceled by the client.

disabled_message.description: A message explaining why cancellation is disabled, if applicable. Only present when allowed is false.

confirmed_at.description: Time at which the object was confirmed.

end_at.description: An object describing a date/time in local time and in UTC.

local.description: The local date/time in ISO-8601 format, including the UTC offset (e.g., `2025-03-01T10:00:00-05:00`).

time_zone.description: The time zone of the local time (IANA format).

unix_ts.description: The UTC date/time in Unix timestamp format (seconds).

utc.description: The UTC date/time in ISO-8601 format (with time zone information).

end_at.title: ZonedDateTime

rescheduling.description: Information about whether the appointment can be rescheduled by the client.

allowed.description: Whether the appointment can be rescheduled by the client.

disabled_message.description: A message explaining why rescheduling is disabled, if applicable. Only present when allowed is false.

start_at.description: An object describing a date/time in local time and in UTC.

unix_ts.description: The UTC date/time in Unix timestamp format (seconds).
